note: Six Hoosier NF rows. Two general campgrounds added; four are horse camps built around trailheads, and excluded as such.

excluded.name: Blackwell Campground
excluded.why: FS: 'a popular destination and overnight camping area for equestrians ... facilities are geared to provide for horses'; no designated sites, an open grassy field for ~100 horse trailers with corrals and hitching rails

excluded.name: Hickory Ridge Campground
excluded.why: primitive trailhead camp with a horse water trough and mounting ramp; no stated site lengths

excluded.name: Shirley Creek Campground
excluded.why: free primitive trailhead camp with hitching racks and livestock water; no stated site lengths

excluded.name: Youngs Creek Campground
excluded.why: primitive trailhead camp with high-line posts at every site and non-potable hydrants; no stated site lengths
